statement: For the precise interpretation frozen in problem.md, m_2(4) >= 18: no finite poset of width exactly two and order at most 17 has gap_P(C)>4 for every nonempty inclusion-maximal chain C.
contribution: An exact reproducible computational lower bound for the new finite-threshold question. The proof exhausts all two-chain presentations through order 17 using integer extension counts and rank sums; it does not determine m_2(4), classify minimizers, or claim priority beyond the limited literature screen.
